why_u2_is_not_decorative: the ruling cites a BAND. A band is the two-sided claim 'below 1 is wrong AND 87-and-above is wrong' -- it needs TWO bounds, derived independently. Checking only 'the value is 5 and 5 is inside [1,86]' would assume the band it was asked to verify. The object is a band, so the criterion must be the two bounds, not a single point. The bounds come from OPPOSITE concerns (an honest sample must not be killed vs. a reproduced defect must not be let through), which is what makes the band meaningful.
